qualifications: This is a finite invariant and regression review, not proof that arbitrary future prose is semantically correct.

The price gate covers recognized explicit numeric price/unit assertions; it is not a universal numeric verifier, physical conversion routine, source unit price validation or official settlement score.
Known foreign-price/cost controls ensure they are not forced into the TTF unit. Cross-instrument spreads or unsupported units outside this finite task were not broadly redesigned.
Degree of future news pressure is a model judgment, distinct from measured global physical loss, verified absence of a price reaction or target settlement outcome.
A pure replay can show the old false-positive gate is corrected; it cannot retroactively turn the original fifth failed run into actual delivery success.
